headline: Xocalı mountain district features sparse transport links and extensive forest cover.

tags.reason: Forest cover reaches 51.2% with a nature index of 67, compared to the national median of 51.

summary: Xocalı is a mountain district with a population of 15,700 and a low population density of 17 people per square kilometre. The transport index stands at 46 against a national median of 47, supported by 5 bus stops and 0 metro stations. The infrastructure index is 42 with a paved road share of 16.2%, while the national median paved share is 4.35%. Nature and environment conditions include a PM2.5 model value of 12.9 and forest cover of 51.2%.
strengths: High forest cover across the mountain terrain (51.2% forest landcover; national median 51).
Paved road share exceeds the national median (16.2% paved roads; national median 4.35%).
Nature index is above the national benchmark (nature index 67; national median 51).
weaknesses: Transport index is slightly below the national median (transport index 46; national median 47).
Low population density limits local public transit services (population density 17 persons/km²; national median 81).
Infrastruktur index remains below the national benchmark (infrastruktur index 42; national median 45).
